scripts.build: bun run comfy:sync && bun run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:preview: node ../../scripts/increment-build-number.mjs --check editor && bun run build -- --mode preview && rm -rf dist/preview && electron-builder --config electron-builder.preview.yml --config.buildVersion=$(node -p "require('./package.json').build.buildVersion") --config.artifactName="$KASTARD_ARTIFACT_NAME" --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.build:production: node ../../scripts/increment-build-number.mjs --check editor && bun run build -- --mode production && rm -rf dist/production && electron-builder --config electron-builder.production.yml --config.buildVersion=$(node -p "require('./package.json').build.buildVersion") --config.extraMetadata.version="$KASTARD_PRODUCT_VERSION" --config.artifactName="$KASTARD_ARTIFACT_NAME" --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:node && bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:scripts
scripts.e2e: bun run electron:install && bun run build && playwright test
scripts.e2e:local-worker: bun run electron:install && bun run build && KASTARD_LOCAL_WORKER_E2E=1 playwright test e2e/local-worker.spec.ts
